Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Locksmith Solutions Inc. provides a range of locksmith services including residential and commercial lock installations, repairs, and key duplication. Our operations prioritize customer security and satisfaction, employing skilled technicians with extensive training in safety protocols. We maintain a secure, alarmed facility with controlled access for our tools and inventory to mitigate risks. Additionally, we uphold strict data protection measures to safeguard client information and prevent cyber exposure. Comprehensive safety plans are in place for any instructional activities, ensuring that all training courses are conducted in small groups within a controlled environment to minimize liability.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In the past three years, Locksmith Solutions Inc. experienced a minor theft incident on 05/12/2022, where tools valued at $2,500 were stolen from our secure facility due to a break-in. The crime was reported to local authorities, and the claim was settled by our previous insurer. The facility has since upgraded security measures, including enhanced alarm systems and surveillance, to prevent future incidents. Status: Closed.
